title: Hunting predators on fuel-driven condensate prey: with predators that drift down the fuel gradient toward prey (nonreciprocal taxis) and eat cooperatively (k2 c_a^2 c_b^2, so the dissolved prey feeds them only marginally), prey keep nucleating and being eaten and predators persist, with no freeze, to t=12000
summary: world.py = 20261026T1851-c46-driven-prey-fuel-fork world plus two predator terms: drift of predator material down grad F (chiF, MUSCL volume-filling flux; prey consume fuel, so the fuel well marks them; prey do not respond) and eat = k2 c_a^ne c_b^2. With ne 1 the predators live on dissolved prey and exterminate the prey; with ne 2, chiF 1 and kq 0.0015 (run WORLD_P {"chiF":1,"ne":2,"kq":0.0015}, seed 0, 128^2), predators added as noise at t=2000 eat all 18 prey bodies, prey re-nucleate from the bath from t~3500, and from then on 2-10 prey bodies at a time nucleate, grow and are found and eaten by 8-18 predator droplets that dim between meals and swell after them (sheet_n2q15.png, counts_n2q15.png). At kq 0.002 the predators nearly die out after the first meal and then return with the prey in a slower boom-bust (counts_n2q20.png). Labkit (K=5): predator tracks are short (no persistent tracks), 0-1 persistent predator splits: these predators do not yet divide; seed 0 only.
